senses.title: Main character

definition_en: the one or ones belonging to her
core_image: 一份属于她的东西，被单独拿在手里
scene: 那个红包是她的。The red envelope is hers.
sceneCN: 这里 hers 是「她的（东西）」（第 1 个义项）；句意：那个红包是她的。

senses.title: Her thing
senses.definition: the thing or things belonging to her
senses.definitionCN: 属于她的那个或那些东西
senses.example: The red envelope is hers.
senses.exampleCN: 那个红包是她的。
senses.why: This is the basic possessive pronoun sense.

senses.title: Her responsibility
senses.definition: the responsibility or choice that belongs to her

intro.en: Hers is the possessive form built from her.
intro.cn: hers 是由 her 构成的物主代词形式。

items.en: The pronouns had separate possessive forms.

items.en: Hire marked what belonged to her.
items.cn: hire 标示属于她的东西。

items.en: Her took over the possessive use.
items.cn: her 接替了表示所属的用法。

items.en: Hers stayed unchanged in form.

note.en: Hers is compared with look-alike words and with related pronouns.

entries.definition: the subject form for a female person

normalIntro.en: Hers stands alone in place of her plus a noun.
normalIntro.cn: hers 单独使用，代替 her 加一个名词。

normal.en: The red envelope is hers.
The final choice is hers.
She introduced a friend of hers.
normal.cn: 她介绍了一位她的朋友。

normal.en: The old house was hers alone.
This coat is mine, and that one is hers.
normal.cn: 这件外套是我的，那件是她的。

abstract.en: Hers is a small word that draws a line around a life.
abstract.cn: hers 是个小词，却为一段人生画出一条界限。

abstract.en: What is hers cannot be borrowed without a promise.
abstract.cn: 属于她的东西，不经承诺不能借走。

abstract.en: A name in hers is a small claim on the world.
abstract.cn: 名字后面加上 hers，就是对这世界的一点主张。

examples.en: The red envelope is hers.
examples.cn: 那个红包是她的。

examples.en: The final choice is hers.
examples.cn: 最后的选择权在她。

examples.en: She introduced a friend of hers.

dict_mnemonic.text: hers 是名词性的物主代词「她的」，后面不再接名词；her 后面要接名词，hers 单独使用，a friend of hers 是她的一个朋友。

root: 由女性代词 her 发展而来；中古英语以后，her 承担了带名词的所属用法，hers 则成为单独使用、后面不再接名词的物主代词。

sensesIntro.en: Hers means the thing belonging to her, or the responsibility that is hers.
sensesIntro.cn: hers 表示属于她的东西，或该由她承担的责任。

core.en: A thing held alone, marked as belonging to her.

branches.en: The red envelope is hers.

branches.en: The final choice is hers.
branches.cn: 最后的选择权在她。

branches.en: A thing and a duty can both be hers.
branches.cn: 一件东西和一份责任，都可以是她的。

branches.en: The old house was hers alone.
branches.cn: 那座老房子只属于她。

branches.en: The blame, if any, is hers.
branches.cn: 若有责任，也在她。

intro.en: Hers belongs to the small set of possessive pronouns.

definition_en: her own self, used when she does and receives an action, or for emphasis
core_image: 一个人转过身，手指指向自己
scene: 她给自己倒了杯茶。She poured herself a cup of tea.
sceneCN: 这里 herself 是「她自己」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她给自己倒了杯茶。

senses.title: Reflexive
senses.definition: used when the same female person does and receives an action
senses.definitionCN: 当同一位女性既是动作发出者又是承受者时使用
senses.example: She poured herself a cup of tea.
senses.exampleCN: 她给自己倒了杯茶。
senses.why: This is the core reflexive sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的反身义项。

senses.title: For emphasis
senses.definition: used to emphasize that she, and not someone else, did something
senses.definitionCN: 强调是她本人而不是别人做了某事
senses.example: She herself opened the door.
senses.exampleCN: 她亲自开了门。
senses.why: The same form adds emphasis.
senses.whyCN: 同一形式也可用来加强语气。

intro.en: Herself joins the pronoun her with the old word self.
intro.cn: herself 由代词 her 与古老的 self 组合而成。

items.en: Self named a person's own being.
items.cn: self 指一个人自身。

items.en: Hire selfum meant to her own self.
items.cn: hire selfum 意为给她自己。

items.en: Herself became one reflexive word.
items.cn: herself 成为一个反身代词。

items.en: Herself also served to add emphasis.
items.cn: herself 也用来加强语气。

items.en: By herself came to mean alone.

note.en: Herself is compared with other reflexive pronouns and with related forms.

She herself opened the door.
She finished the work by herself.
She told herself to stay calm.
normal.cn: 她告诉自己要保持冷静。

normal.en: The manager herself came to help.

abstract.en: Herself is the person she meets when the room is empty.
abstract.cn: herself 是房间空下来时她遇见的那个人。

abstract.en: To be by herself is not the same as being alone.
abstract.cn: 独自一人，不等于孤单。

abstract.en: She must become herself before she becomes anyone else's.
abstract.cn: 她得先成为她自己，才能成为别人的谁。

examples.en: She poured herself a cup of tea.
examples.cn: 她给自己倒了杯茶。

examples.en: She herself opened the door.

examples.en: She finished the work by herself.

core.en: A finger turned back toward the one who points.

branches.en: She herself opened the door.

branches.en: The same word receives an act and stresses the doer.

branches.en: She told herself to stay calm.
branches.cn: 她告诉自己要保持冷静。

branches.en: The manager herself came to help.

definition_en: to pause before acting because of doubt, or to be unwilling
core_image: 脚已经抬起，却在门前停住
scene: 她在门口犹豫了一会儿才敲门。She hesitated at the door before knocking.
sceneCN: 这里 hesitate 是「犹豫」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她在门口犹豫了一会儿才敲门。

senses.title: Pause in doubt
senses.definition: to pause before doing something because you are not sure
senses.definitionCN: 因不确定而在行动前停顿
senses.example: She hesitated at the door before knocking.
senses.exampleCN: 她在门口犹豫了一会儿才敲门。

senses.title: Be unwilling
senses.definition: to be unwilling to do something
senses.definitionCN: 不愿意做某事
senses.example: He hesitated to tell them the truth.
senses.exampleCN: 他不愿把真相告诉他们。
senses.why: Reluctance also makes a person pause.
senses.whyCN: 不情愿也会让人停顿。

items.cn: haesitare 意为黏住或迟疑。

normalIntro.en: To hesitate is to stand still inside a decision.
normalIntro.cn: hesitate 就是在一个决定里站着不动。

normal.cn: 她在门口犹豫了一会儿才敲门。

normal.cn: 他不愿把真相告诉他们。

examples.en: She hesitated at the door before knocking.

abstract.cn: 我们记住命中的那一下，忘掉挥空的那些。

examples.en: The ball hit him on the shoulder.
examples.cn: 球击中了他的肩膀。

examples.en: The car hit a tree.
examples.cn: 汽车撞上了一棵树。

examples.en: Her new song is a hit.
examples.cn: 她的新歌很受欢迎。

dict_mnemonic.text: hit 是「打击、碰撞」，也可指「热门作品」；hit the ball 是击球，hit the target 是命中目标，hit song 是热门歌曲。

root: 可能来自古诺尔斯语 hitta（遇见、碰上），进入中古英语后成为表示击打的常用词，后又引申为风行一时的作品。

sensesIntro.en: Hit means to strike, to crash into, or a very popular work.
sensesIntro.cn: hit 表示击打、撞上，或指非常受欢迎的作品。

core.en: One thing meeting another with force.
core.cn: 一个东西用力碰上另一个东西。

branches.en: The ball hit him on the shoulder.
branches.cn: 球击中了他的肩膀。

branches.en: The car hit a tree.
branches.cn: 汽车撞上了一棵树。

branches.en: Her new song is a hit.
branches.cn: 她的新歌很受欢迎。

branches.en: Striking and colliding are both forceful meetings.
branches.cn: 击打和碰撞，都是用力的相遇。

branches.en: A song can hit the public like a blow.
branches.cn: 一首歌也能像一击那样击中大众。

intro.en: Hit builds hits, hitting, hitter, and hitman.
intro.cn: hit 可构成 hits、hitting、hitter 和 hitman。

latinIntro.en: Hit comes from Old Norse, not from Latin.
latinIntro.cn: hit 来自古诺尔斯语，而不是拉丁语。

items.example: The rain is hitting the roof.

items.exampleCN: 这部电影讲述一名杀手。
她是一位著名的热门歌曲制作人。

items.example: The plan was on the hit list.
items.exampleCN: 这个计划被列在待处理名单上。

definition_en: to keep something in your hand, to have an event, or to contain something
core_image: 双手稳稳地托住一件易碎的东西
scene: 她手里握着一封旧信。She holds an old letter in her hand.
sceneCN: 这里 hold 是「握住」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她手里握着一封旧信。

senses.title: Grasp
senses.definition: to keep something in your hand
senses.definitionCN: 把东西拿在手里
senses.example: She holds an old letter in her hand.
senses.exampleCN: 她手里握着一封旧信。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Have an event
senses.definition: to have a meeting, party, or event
senses.definitionCN: 举办会议、聚会或活动
senses.example: They hold a meeting every Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们每周五举行会议。
senses.why: Here hold means to make an event happen.
senses.whyCN: 这里 hold 表示使活动发生。

senses.title: Contain
senses.definition: to be able to contain a number of things
senses.definitionCN: 能够装下一定数量的东西
senses.example: The hall holds two hundred people.
senses.exampleCN: 大厅能容纳两百人。
senses.why: The word measures capacity.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项表示容量。

senses.title: Remain true
senses.definition: to remain true or in effect
senses.definitionCN: 依然成立或有效
senses.example: The old rule still holds.
senses.exampleCN: 那条旧规则依然有效。
senses.why: Here nothing is grasped; a fact stands firm.
senses.whyCN: 这里没有抓住任何东西，而是事实稳住了。

intro.en: Hold is an old word for keeping and guarding.
intro.cn: hold 是表示保持与守护的古老词汇。

items.en: Healdan meant to keep or guard.
items.cn: healdan 意为保持或守护。

items.en: Healdan also meant to grasp.
items.cn: healdan 也表示抓住。

items.en: Hold meant to keep in the hand.
items.cn: hold 意为拿在手里。

items.en: Hold widened to meetings and capacity.
items.cn: hold 扩展到举行活动和容纳。

items.en: It also means to remain true.
items.cn: 它也表示依然成立。

note.en: Hold is compared with look-alike words and with words for grasping.
note.cn: 把 hold 与形近词以及表示抓握的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: To hold is to keep something from falling or leaving.
normalIntro.cn: hold 就是让某物不掉下去、不离开。

normal.en: She holds an old letter in her hand.
They hold a meeting every Friday.
The hall holds two hundred people.
The old rule still holds.
Hold on, I am almost ready.

abstract.en: To hold on is sometimes the whole of courage.
abstract.cn: 有时候，坚持下去就是全部的勇气。

abstract.en: We hold things until they hold us.
abstract.cn: 我们握着东西，直到被它们握住。

abstract.en: What you hold loosely is hardest to take.
abstract.cn: 握得最松的东西，最难被夺走。

examples.en: She holds an old letter in her hand.
examples.cn: 她手里握着一封旧信。

examples.en: They hold a meeting every Friday.
examples.cn: 他们每周五举行会议。

examples.en: The hall holds two hundred people.
examples.cn: 大厅能容纳两百人。

dict_mnemonic.text: hold 是「握住、举行、容纳、保持」；hold hands 是牵手，hold a meeting 是开会，hold on 是坚持或稍等，holder 是持有者。

root: 来自古英语 healdan，意为保持、守护、抓住，属日耳曼语固有词，后扩展出举行、容纳、有效等义。

sensesIntro.en: Hold means to grasp, to stage an event, to contain, or to remain valid.
sensesIntro.cn: hold 表示握住、举办活动、容纳，或保持有效。

core.en: Keeping something firmly in place.
core.cn: 把某物稳稳地保持在原处。

branches.en: She holds an old letter in her hand.
branches.cn: 她手里握着一封旧信。

branches.en: They hold a meeting every Friday.
branches.cn: 他们每周五举行会议。

branches.en: The hall holds two hundred people.
branches.cn: 大厅能容纳两百人。

branches.en: The old rule still holds.
branches.cn: 那条旧规则依然有效。

branches.en: A hand holds a letter and a hall holds a crowd.
branches.cn: 手握着信，大厅容纳着人群。

intro.en: Hold builds holds, held, holder, and holdup.
intro.cn: hold 可构成 holds、held、holder 和 holdup。

latinIntro.en: Hold is Germanic in origin, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: hold 源自日耳曼语，而不是拉丁语。

There was a holdup on the road.
